title: xmldiffreport recipe
description: Schema for the parsed form of an xmldiffreport recipe (.toml). Validates the dict produced by tomllib.

applied_env.description: Name of the 'already applied' environment; pairs involving it are classified INFO instead of CONFLICT.

unit.description: Tag of the comparison unit. If omitted, the root's direct children are the units.

unordered.description: Match children by key rather than by position (default true).

ignore_attrs.description: Attribute names treated as volatile and never reported.

key.description: Identity tokens joined by '|'. Tokens: @ATTR, #text, *tag, *kinds, child:TAG@ATTR, child:TAG#text.

inline.description: Treat children as pseudo-attributes instead of opening a new level.
